生成的配置应该放在哪里？: Where should the generated config be placed?
在 Debian/Ubuntu 上通常放到 /etc/nginx/sites-a: On Debian/Ubuntu it usually goes to /etc/nginx/sites-available/ and is symlinked into /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/, or written directly as a .conf under /etc/nginx/conf.d/. After changes, validate with nginx -t, then gracefully reload with nginx -s reload.
SPA（单页应用）和静态站有什么区别？: What is the difference between a SPA (single-page app) and a static site?
静态站使用 try_files $uri $uri/ =404;，找不到文件即返: A static site uses try_files $uri $uri/ =404; and returns 404 when a file is not found; a SPA uses try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html; to fall back all unknown paths to the entry index.html, handled by the front-end router, ideal for React, Vue and similar frameworks.
反向代理如何透传真实客户端信息？: How does a reverse proxy pass through real client info?
生成器会写入 proxy_set_header Host、X-Real-IP、X: The generator writes proxy_set_header Host, X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-For and X-Forwarded-Proto so the backend can get the real client IP and protocol. With WebSocket enabled it also adds the Upgrade and Connection headers.
